EmailTemplate.name: Contact Hard Bounce
EmailTemplate.subject: Contact Hard Bounce
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Sorry to hear that.
We checked your account and found that an email hard bounce has occurred.
We have removed the bounce so emails will resume flowing to you, but the best way to prevent a bounce is to work with your IT to implement the IP whitelisting rules in the attached file.
Please let us know if the issue persists after following the instructions on how to whitelist EG emails.
Thank you,
{!EmailMessage.FromName}
